_doc: Portal list for tools/ats_scan.mjs — free zero-token ATS discovery. greenhouse/ashby use `api` or `careers_url`; workday/smartrecruiters use `careers_url` (provider derives the endpoint). Verify: node tools/ats_scan.mjs tools/portals.json (right token → jobs; wrong → 404/422 or WRONG COMPANY — always eyeball the first title). Providers: greenhouse, ashby, lever, workday, smartrecruiters, workable, recruitee, bamboohr, teamtailor, breezy, personio, rippling, successfactors, avature, jibeapply (+ job boards; see ../career-ops/providers/). NO iCIMS/Taleo/Oracle/Eightfold provider — those companies stay on Apify. Workday tenants self-bound via ctx.sinceMs early-stop (since_days). All tokens below VERIFIED live 2026-07-03.
_freshness_note: since_days = DAILY window (7d) — keeps the run fast (Workday early-stops on first_published; ~5s) and catches newly-opened roles; dedup (seen_jobs.csv) is the real duplicate guard. Greenhouse date = first_published (original open date, not repost). ATS rows are direct-from-employer 'listed = open' — do NOT apply the LinkedIn 3-day staleness gate to them. To sweep the EXISTING open-role backlog when adding a company, run a ONE-TIME backfill: `node tools/ats_scan.mjs --since-days 120` (slower; wide global Workday tenants like GE Vernova hit the page cap and add non-US noise — a location filter is the next refinement).
_location_note: US-only (Sid is on OPT, US-based). Empty location passes (don't punish missing data); always_allow beats block; block = major offshore hubs (cuts global-board noise from Bosch/GE Vernova/etc.); allow empty → US cities like 'Warren, MI' pass. Trims non-US, not a hard gate — Step 4 logistics still applies.

portals.name: Robert Bosch
portals.note: Tier1 in-state, heavy sponsor. It's the single heaviest portal — SmartRecruiters has NO incremental/windowed fetch, so it pulls all ~4650 postings every run (~23s of HTTP), then location_filter keeps ~14 US quality roles (7d) / ~43 (30d). BUT concurrency-5 runs it in parallel with the Workday tenants, so total wall-clock stays ~30s. Free/zero-token. Park if ever a problem.
